english:
Arc Weapon Kills grant 2 Counter Points against Combatants and 4 against Guardians, with a 20% chance of granting a bonus 1 point.

Reaching 12 Counter Points spawns an <arc/>Arc Elemental Orb.

Arc Orbs remain on the ground for up to 20 seconds before expiring, and can be held for up to 20 seconds once picked up.

An Arc Orb deals up to <pve 405 /> <pvp [101] /> damage, scaling down to 90% damage, and applies <arc Jolt /> to enemies within 8 meters.

source.text:
Upon reaching 12 Counter Points through Arc Weapon Kills:
Combatant = +2 | Guardian = +4 
Arc Weapon Kills have a 20% chance of granting a bonus +1
Spawns an Arc Elemental Orb.

Arc Elemental Orb:
Arc Orbs remain on the ground for up to 20 seconds before expiring.
Arc Orbs that are picked up can be held for up to 20 seconds.

Arc Orbs deal up to 405 [101] damage, down to 90% damage, and inflict Jolt over 8 meters.
